opportunities.title: $1 Billion in Six Months: The H1 2026 Hack Tally Nobody Learned From
opportunities.why_now: Blockaid's H1 2026 report just confirmed crypto hack losses topped $1B with Ethereum and Solana leading, capping a week that added Triple-A, Garden Finance, and WEMIX to the pile.
opportunities.angle: Data-led postmortem: chart the H1 losses by chain/exploit type and argue the pattern (bridges, contract logic, treasury wallets) is now a permanent tax on the industry, not an anomaly

opportunities.title: Triple-A's $11.8M Treasury Breach Is the Same Story With a New Name
opportunities.why_now: Triple-A just confirmed a treasury-wallet breach hitting $11.8M, days after Blockaid flagged treasury wallets as a top attack vector for H1 2026.
opportunities.angle: Incident teardown: walk through what a 'treasury wallet breach' actually means operationally and why multisig/custody hygiene keeps failing at the same step

opportunities.title: SummerFi Didn't Retire, It Got Exploited Into Retirement
opportunities.why_now: SummerFi is winding down after seven years and explicitly citing an exploit, a rare admission that a hack — not market conditions — killed a legacy DeFi protocol.
opportunities.angle: Obituary format: use SummerFi as a case study in how a single exploit can end a multi-year protocol, and what that says about DeFi's risk tolerance ceiling

opportunities.title: Apple's App Store Just Let a Fake Wallet Drain $1.8M in Bitcoin
opportunities.why_now: A newly filed lawsuit says a counterfeit iPhone wallet app slipped past Apple's review and stole $1.8M, reviving the 'walled garden' security myth.
opportunities.angle: Consumer-security explainer: why app store vetting doesn't catch crypto-drainer apps, with a checklist for verifying wallet apps before download

opportunities.title: An AI Just Cracked Post-Quantum Crypto Humans Couldn't Break — Read That Again
opportunities.why_now: Reports say Anthropic's Claude broke a post-quantum cryptography scheme that had resisted years of human cryptanalysis, a live preview of the threat model crypto security teams have been modeling in theory.
opportunities.angle: Forward-looking security analysis: what this means for crypto's quantum-resistance roadmaps and whether 'post-quantum' claims across chains are actually tested against AI-assisted attacks
